summary_hint: SSN card copy — name_on_card, SSN, employment_restriction_legend or 'unrestricted'; whose card this is and whether the card carries a work-authorization legend

typed_core.name: issuer_name
typed_core.why: identity/source — issuing authority (Social Security Administration); authenticity signal

typed_core.name: name_on_card
typed_core.why: identity — the individual on the card; match to borrower

typed_core.name: social_security_number
typed_core.why: PII (highly_restricted); identity — the card's headline value

typed_core.name: employment_restriction_legend
typed_core.why: processor — work-authorization legend, the card's only eligibility-relevant fact
typed_core.prompt_hint: Capture the employment-restriction legend verbatim; absence of a legend means unrestricted and should be recorded as null, not fabricated

typed_core.name: signature_present
typed_core.why: processor — whether the card is signed (authenticity/validity indicator)
typed_core.prompt_hint: The signature line presence is an authenticity signal, not a name — record present/absent only

typed_core.name: copy_front_present
typed_core.why: processor/completeness — confirms the front image is present
typed_core.prompt_hint: If both front and back are imaged, note each; a back-only or number-only copy is incomplete

typed_core.name: copy_back_present
typed_core.why: processor/completeness — confirms the back image is present

rejected.name: document_title, form_number, form_revision_date
rejected.reason: the card is not a titled/numbered form

rejected.name: all Dates fields (issue/effective/expiration/statement period)
rejected.reason: a Social Security card carries no dates

rejected.name: party_names, party_addresses
rejected.reason: duplicate name_on_card; no address on the card

rejected.name: card_version_or_design
rejected.reason: cosmetic; no rule, no processor use

encoding_variations: SSN prints as NNN-NN-NNNN; capture the grouping verbatim, normalize on read

The work-restriction legend appears in three forms: no legend (unrestricted), 'VALID FOR WORK ONLY WITH DHS AUTHORIZATION', or 'NOT VALID FOR EMPLOYMENT' — these invert eligibility, so the legend text is its own disambiguator and must be captured verbatim, not collapsed to a boolean
Card design/era varies (blue newer vs older stock); not decision-relevant, dropped

open_questions.q: copy_back_present value — OPTIONAL in the catalog; kept as a cheap completeness flag.
open_questions.recommendation: if processors never require the back, drop it and keep only copy_front_present

open_questions.q: Legend as enum vs verbatim str — no enum coercer exists, and the three legend states invert work eligibility.
open_questions.recommendation: verbatim str; flag if downstream wants a normalized enum added deliberately

notes: A photocopy/scan of the physical Social Security card. It carries almost no structured data: a name, the SSN, and possibly a work-restriction legend. No rule reads it. The schema exists mainly to promote the SSN out of the unmasked catch-all and to record the work-eligibility legend, the only decision-relevant fact the card can add.

social_security_number needs _PII_FIELDS registration, pre_masked false (the card shows the full number; snapshot must mask + add match-hash); distinct from the registered taxpayer_ssn_masked. name_on_card is kept typed for identity, not a registry element under the current 7-field pattern.
Prompt hint (doc-level): Tell the model this is an image of the physical card, not an SSA letter — expect only name, number, and possibly a legend.
